title: Road Trips and Family Reunions
content: About half my Mall World dreams are basically road trips and family reunions. Most of the time when it comes to my road trip dreams, I am just with my parents inside a hotel packing things up for a long time and then somehow when we are out in the roads trying to return home from our vacation, we somehow get a stuck in a huge traffic. For some reason, it's always a long way back. Now regarding family reunions, I am just usually spending my time watching TV. I pretty much do the same thing when I am inside a hotel room. Anyone else here have road trips and family reunion dreams in Mall World?
